description: Requires signing in to GearHost. The domain names the user saved for later (with save_domain or in the GearHost panel), each re-checked with the registry: available, taken (someone else registered it) or unknown. Read-only; nothing is bought. Returns structuredContent { status, domains:[{domain, availability, note, saved_at, checked_at}] }.
name: list_saved_domains
title: List saved domains
